featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Pandey
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking for a harmonium class nearby and since this music class had good reviews here I joined it during my vacation and truly regretted it. I took class for a month, had classes twice a week so it was around 8~9 sessions.. and during that whole time the teacher used to gimme just one shloka /mantra /poems/songs and gave their notations.. NO BASICS , NO THEORY , NO ALANKARAS , NO EAR TRAINING,  NO RAGAS , LITERALLY NOTHING. And even though as a beginner i had no clue about what's the right teaching flow and lessons.. but after few sessions i realised that this way how am I even going to learn to play something by my own just by listening a song? So i asked my cousin who also is a harmonium player and is just 14 y/o, taught it while he just 9 and he just took class for 1.5 years. And he plays amazingly beautiful.. he can play any song he listens to. So I asked him that how did your guru taught you.  So he explained me like the whole thing that first you need to master the alankaras his guru made him practice it for 6 months , then ragas, these are the base of hindustani music.. it helps you to train your ears to understand swaras of any music you hear... I remember there was a guy in this class who was there for like around 2 years and I asked him if you're now able to play piano on your on without memorising the notations every time.. and he said no... like this class is such a waste of time and money... now when I've doing classes from the guru my cousin was doing from, i am absolutely content by seeing that i am actually learning hindustani classical rather than playing those childish happy birthday and poems.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been learning piano with Leena Mistry, currently teaching at Solfege Academy, for over 8 years now. The school is in a very quiet neighborhood and all the teachers are very helpful. The monthly workshops help us to get the critical reviews of our piano pieces from all the teachers and the cupcakes at the end are most delicious.

Being an adult, it is very difficult to learn a new instrument with no previous knowledge. I have been learning at my own steady pace over these years, starting learning on digital piano and upgraded to an acoustic piano 2 years back. An acoustic piano makes a huge difference in learning. Leena is a great teacher, very calm and professional. Leena understands the requirements of different students and alters her teaching methods accordingly. She has made learning much more fun and easy and made me continue for so long! Thanks a lot Leena!

featured_reviews.name: Shubha Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are very happy to have found a teacher like Leena! Her patient and caring nature coupled with her attention to details has made a positive impact on our daughter and has inculcated in her a deep appreciation of music. While staying focused has always been a bit of a challenge for our young daughter, Leena's methodical tutoring and encouragement has continued to keep her engaged for close to two years.

The regular workshops and the end of the year concert arranged by Leena highlight the importance of performing music in front of an audience and is a great learning experience for all the students and audience alike. Leena provides the best opportunities for her students to shine! Her thoughtful arrangements for the workshops and concert are truly the mark of a fantastic teacher who cares deeply for music and her students.

featured_reviews.name: Jonathan Paul
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a professional pianist and music educator living in mumbai for the past 20 years, it has been my eternal search to find a safe, comfortable and inspiring space for piano learning, practice and development. I am wonderstruck by the beautiful set up created by Leena and her world class group of excellent pianists and teachers. 🤩Solfège Academy is a gift to the city of Mumbai (and indeed our country) and with the quality of teaching and intelligently designed piano practice space, I would not be surprised if it will give birth to future piano and music stars in our country. ( There is no other place in India where students are taught and can practice on original Steinway Pianos!! )The students here will have an opportunity to practice on the best pianos available in the world. In the last 75 years this has not been possible in India for anyone who doesn’t own a Steinway!

Kudos to Leena and team for creating such a beautiful environment to learn the piano and nurture the next generation. All my best wishes and I look forward to spending quality time here myself more often.

featured_reviews.name: Vinay Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been learning the piano from Leena for around 2 years, and I am very happy with my progress. Leena is passionate about teaching the piano and her approach to learning is realistic, systematic, and yet gives the student the freedom to play what they like so that they enjoy the music. Her attention to detail and supportive in-class guidance constantly helps me gain confidence. She is one of the rare piano teachers in Mumbai who welcomes students of all ages (I am an adult). Leena earned her ABRSM Diploma from London, plays the clarinet and is avidly involved in much of the Mumbai classical music scene.

Honestly didn’t know a single chord when I started with Rajiv about 1.5 years ago, and now I’ve got 20-25 songs under my belt and I’m actually gearing up for my Grade 1 Trinity exam. Still can’t quite believe it!

What I love about learning with him is that it never feels generic. He picks up on exactly what I need to work on and gives me exercises and feedback that are specific to my playing, so I’m not just mindlessly strumming through the same stuff every week.

He’s also super flexible with scheduling which, as someone with a pretty hectic work life, means a lot.

Genuinely would recommend Rajiv to anyone, beginner or not. One of those people you just trust completely from the first lesson.

featured_reviews.name: Alvin Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Its only been a few months learning to play the Guitar with Rajiv but I can certainly vouch for the fact that it's been an extremely wonderful experience. To start with Rajiv takes a lot of effort in teaching basic concepts along with making sure that there's something new I'm learning every session. Guitar lessons have never been so simple and while it's still a long way to go, there's a lot which I can learn going forward. Rajiv is extremely patient and has been very approachable with all my doubts and queries (however stupid they may seem). He also spends a lot of time in actually teaching the why's and what's of a Guitar, so that other than just being able to play a song, I'm also aware of what the source of its derivation is. I'm extremely thankful for somehow managing to find a coach like Rajiv and I hope to continue working and learning alongside him.
